operation_lock_order: runner nonblocking then state; no locks acquired in this task
provider: current official gpt-6-astra account via existing codex_cli only; no provider/login/network work in preparation
import_policy: source-only bootstrap -I -S -B; ignores inherited PYTHONPATH; explicit isolated source and three vendored package roots plus interpreter paths only; no site startup/.pth; live source attestation rejects resolved search entries outside source/interpreter prefix; no adjacent checkout paths

receipt_policy.before: In actual admitted worker, before Main, capture process/context/runtime_closure bound runtime, loaded source, source-execution and native-build observations using exclusive create + fsync + read-only mode. Hash-bind retained before file in final worker receipt.
receipt_policy.after: Same PID/boot_id/start ticks, after Main and native audits, capture separate after file once; parent hashes files and checks exact embedded observations, inventories, generated-runtime ownership, CUDA UUID, controller instances, all native gates and before/after continuity. Missing/partial/tampered receipt yields INVALID and retains charge.
receipt_policy.immutability_limit: Exclusive create and read-only mode prevent normal overwrite; SHA-256 references detect later changes. This is hash-bound retention, not filesystem WORM or protection against a privileged malicious writer.

readiness: Future independent release must refresh source/runtime reviews and device/provider/accounting/STOP/time evidence. Historical booleans and CPU readiness are not production evidence.
